name: Honda CB200
engine: 198 cc air-cooled SOHC parallel twin, two carbs
intro: The CB175's successor. Cheap and simple, but often worked on badly by past owners.

add.title: Inspect the cam and cam chain
add.instructions: Pull the points and tach boxes and check the cam ends for wear, then check the cam chain and tensioner for slack and the tunnel for rubbing marks.
add.reason: Chewed cams and worn cam chains are common on tired CB200s.

B: Expect to find missing washers, loose bolts and odd routing from past owners. Check everything as you go.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Worn cam
known.what: Cam ends and bearing surfaces get chewed up.
